question: An investor tracks 5 stocks. Four of them have an average return of 8%. If the overall average return is 9%, what was the return on the fifth stock?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Overall average of 5 stocks = 9%

Average of 4 stocks = 8%

Deviation of the 4 stocks from the overall average = 4 × (8% − 9%) = −4%

To balance the overall average to 9%, the 5th stock must compensate with a +4% deviation.

Return on 5th stock = 9% + 4% = 13%

**∴ The correct answer is 13%.**
